Introduce your child to a week filled with magic and adventure! The **Sofia Intai** book from Litera is a beautifully illustrated collection designed to provide captivating reading material every single night. Whether you are looking for engaging bedtime stories or structured weekly reading fun, this anthology offers seven unique tales perfect for young readers.

## ð About the Book Collection

This richly illustrated volume contains seven distinct narratives, each corresponding to a different evening of the week. From whimsical princesses to mysterious amulets, Sofia Intai ensures that there is something enchanting for your child to discover night after night. It's the perfect literary journey spanning Monday through Sunday!

**What Makes This Book Special?**
*   **Daily Engagement:** Seven unique stories keep reading material fresh and exciting all week long.
*   **Beautifully Illustrated:** The high-quality illustrations bring every character and scene to life, enhancing the reading experience.
*   **Diverse Themes:** Covering magic, mystery, friendship, and adventure, it appeals to a wide range of interests.

## â¨ A Week of Magical Stories (Story Guide)

The book is structured around seven memorable adventures, ensuring a unique story for every evening:

*   **Monday:** Once upon a time there was a princess.
*   **Tuesday:** The lesson of magic.
*   **Wednesday:** An entanglement with thrilling adventures.
*   **Thursday:** A special party invitation awaits!
*   **Friday:** Discover the mystery of the amulet and anthem.
*   **Saturday:** Join the fun at the Halloween Ball.
*   **Sunday:** Meet Sofia's brand new friend.

Every evening promises a delightful encounter with beloved characters, making storytime an eagerly anticipated ritual.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
